original.target_description: Study 1: planned contrast of decision-process accountability versus outcome accountability on amount allocated to the initially selected beer product, adjusting for initially selected product.

n.sample_role: Participants in decision-process accountability and outcome-accountability conditions, respectively, as printed in the outcome table; the contrast uses a pooled ANOVA error term.
n.exclusions: Not documented for this contrast. The paper reports 193 participants overall; the analytic total underlying the pooled error term is not established.
n.location: p. 424, Table 2, n column, Outcome accountability and Decision process accountability rows

es.location: p. 424, Allocation of Resources, additional planned contrast
es.quote: An additional planned contrast was between process accountability and outcome accountability.

p.location: p. 424, Allocation of Resources, additional planned contrast

replication.target_description: Full replication paper, including the meta-analysis on p. 120, could not be acquired through attempted open routes.

notes: The three assigned inputs have identical descriptions and locators; each independently maps to the same explicit process-versus-outcome planned contrast. They do not identify three distinguishable tests. No standardized effect size is printed for this original contrast, so none was calculated. Original sample values are condition-specific printed n, not a derived sum. The replication abstract/first-page preview was insufficient for the requested p. 120 meta-analysis; no statistics were taken from it.
